commands.review_summary:
The branch adds `media backfill` and `media retry`, once-mode media queue draining, pending-media store queries and migration 20, docs, tests, and changelog entries.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows the store scopes message identity by `(chat_jid, msg_id)`, while `RetryMedia` keys retry state by `msg_id` alone; I did not run a live WhatsApp reproduction in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A focused repair can fix the retry identity bug and remove changelog edits; maintainer product acceptance of the feature/drain behavior remains separate.
